header:
Awesome Marketing Tools

> Open-source tools for email, analytics, SEO, landing pages, A/B testing, CRM and growth. Every entry shows its license. **Rules of this list:** every repo exists, is public, is not archived, states a license and has had a commit in the last year. One plain sentence each. Star counts and claims are the authors' own, we did not test every tool. Checked 2026-10-18. See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).
footer:
## How to choose

- **Respect privacy law.** Email and tracking tools need consent in many countries (GDPR, CAN-SPAM).
- **Self-hosting email is hard.** Deliverability needs proper DNS and a clean sending reputation.
- **Check the license.** Some analytics tools are source-available with limits.
- **Measure one thing first.** Add tools only when a question needs them.

## Contributing
